title: Help for Singaporeans to Obtain Subsidised Rates at Public Hospitals after Expiration of Employer-provided Healthcare Insurance
what_it_is: Help for Singaporeans to Obtain Subsidised Rates at Public Hospitals after Expiration of Employer-provided Healthcare Insurance

sections.label: Hospital financial counselling and ward class
sections.summary: Hospitals counsel patients on ward class, and patients facing expense difficulties can seek case-by-case assistance assessed on factors like bill size and financial means.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Hospitals provide financial counselling to patients prior to or upon admission, to help them select a ward class appropriate to their needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Patients at the public hospitals who face difficulties with their medical expenses and wish to switch from non-subsidised care to subsidised care, can approach the staff at public hospitals for assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Each request is assessed on a case-by-case basis, taking into consideration various factors, such as his bill size, medical condition and any changes in financial means and his ability to pay, including employment status.

sections.label: Assistance for patients in financial difficulty
sections.summary: Hospitals and MOH will assist patients genuinely in financial difficulty regardless of prior employer insurance, but special consideration for means-testing waivers is not granted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: For patients who are genuinely in financial difficulties, the hospitals and MOH will certainly extend our assistance to them, regardless of whether they have been using their employer insurance before they retire.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: I would be reluctant to grant special consideration for patients who, just because they have made use of employer's benefits or insurance, to waive means-testing or to make it easier for them.

sections.label: Dialogue with healthcare insurance industry
sections.summary: MOH holds ongoing dialogue with insurers on MediShield Life, Integrated Plans and other products, and insurers are exploring collaboration with hospitals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: In fact, I just had a session with them last week talking about MediShield Life as well as the private products, Integrated Plans, which ride on MediShield Life.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Insurance companies also have other products that are independent of MediShield Life.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: They are also exploring collaboration with the hospitals, so that they are better able to match in terms of the services provided and the needs of their policyholders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: We do have this constant dialogue and discussion with the industries, on the one hand, to better understand how the industry operates because we do have a very large universal scheme of MediShield; on the other hand, to also understand the difficulties and challenges they face in implementing MediShield Life as well as the Integrated Plan and also to get their input on how we can improve the product offering in terms of the healthcare insurance sector.
